event_series.name: TTW 2026 — Toronto Tech Week
event_series.verdict: Big interest confirmed; entrance strong, visibility landed. Brand pull in Toronto stronger than the proposal assumed.
event_series.ongoing_motion: Recurring smaller, lower-effort happy hours to keep the community warm — lower lift than flagship events.

events.name: Fireside + Roundtables
events.format: Fireside chat (Naveen + Amit) followed by roundtable clusters

turnout.actual_attendance_note: Higher than checked-in — uncounted plus-ones and walk-ins who slipped past check-in. Room ran at/near capacity.

events.audience: Balanced mix of mid-level engineers and professionals; broad career-stage range.
notes: Front of room engaged (listening, photos, well-targeted Q&A); back of room disruptive — had to shush. Venue acoustics not ideal for a listening format.
Fireside length felt right standalone, but back-to-back after the presentation pushed the total content block too long; visible restlessness toward the end.
Roundtable format wasn't enforced — judgment call on the night given crowding and natural mingling.
People sought out Instalily team members organically.
Camera with shared prompts was the unlock — created common ground and a reason to talk to strangers.

events.name: Happy Hour

turnout.actual_attendance_note: Higher than checked-in — some attendees missed registration.

events.audience: Skewed younger and job-seeking — mostly new grads with some mid-level; clearly a networking-driven crowd.
notes: Significant attendee overlap with the Fireside event.

side_activities.name: Hackathon interest
side_activities.learning: Hackathons generated active interest and quality candidates — worth prioritizing for future TTWs.

side_activities.name: Campus walk-throughs
side_activities.learning: Showing up at campuses without a booth didn't convert — need real booth presence to get traction.

engagements.note: Cost likely inside the 'Other' line; not broken out separately.

budget.discrepancy_note: Reported total and line-item sum differ by $0.37 — real data rarely reconciles to the penny; model should flag, not assume.

attendees.note: ~20+ candidates tracked (landed in the 20-30 proposal target). One interview in motion; more than half already applied through the portal. Individual names not provided — 'Recruiting Contacts' section was empty/cut off.

attendee_observations.overlap: Significant overlap between Fireside and Happy Hour attendees — validates cross-event frequency tracking on real data.
attendee_observations.google_turnout: Google showed up in force (Erchit, Naveen, Amit) — partnership is real, not theoretical.

internal_staff.name: Polina
internal_staff.role: Photography lead (ran point; managed the photo vendor)

_contracts_note: No contract records captured in the recap, though venues were paid — exactly the kind of artifact the system should force/preserve.
deliverables_observed: Day-of logistics, merch, and vendor coordination ran cleanly — no major breakage.
(Pre-event deliverables not itemized in recap — this is a post-hoc summary.)
reflections: Build overflow scenarios into the plan from day one: capacity buffers, waitlist policy, second-room or staggered-entry options. Team wasn't operationally built for overflow (528 RSVPs vs 120 cap).
Presentation tech check is SEPARATE from AV check — verify sound routes correctly through the presentation (not just room speakers/mic) before doors open.
Give Instalily staff real, distinct name tags so they're easy to spot in a crowded room (people sought them out organically).
Keep the camera-with-shared-prompts device — it was the social unlock.
Keep content blocks shorter; don't stack fireside back-to-back after a presentation.
Choose venues with acoustics suited to a listening format.
Prioritize hackathons for future TTWs — they generated quality candidates.
Bring a real booth to campuses; walk-throughs without one don't convert.
Add the TTW photography vendor to the preferred Toronto vendor list.
open_questions_from_recap: How to tag/flag candidates in the portal? → directly answered by the recruiting/Greenhouse flow (hire-typed attendee → prospect with event tag).
Recruiting Contacts list — to be populated with actual candidate records.
